answer.rationale: Rollback is unavailable: the in-flight build is a compliance-mandated security patch, so memory_b1 cannot be applied. Circuit breaking would fail writes and violates the no-lost-writes objective (memory_b4 is the wrong failure mode). Write-path p99 at 5x during peak settlement is most consistent with saturated write capacity; memory_b3 is the closest prior success (headroom kept queues flat) and is the load-bearing analog, but it described pre-peak provisioning rather than mid-peak adds, so it is the single record worth verifying. Failover and read-replica routing remain unconfirmed fits (no regional signal; issue is writes, not dashboard reads). Adding capacity is the intervention most likely to keep accepting customer writes; scale stays standard rather than broad because RCA is still unconfirmed and the release timing is only correlative.
